primarySegments: B2B: international tour operators and travel agencies

service.emergencyModel: For group projects, we appoint a contact person before departure, provide the necessary contacts for the stay and coordinate unexpected situations with suppliers and the agency. Availability hours, emergency assistance procedures and service costs are specified in the proposal.

b2b.commissionModel: We offer agencies either a net rate they can mark up independently or, where appropriate, a commissionable rate. The chosen model is set out in the proposal. Pricing depends on the destination, season, group composition, service category and programme customisation.
b2b.whiteLabelScope: We adapt programmes, detailed itineraries and practical travel documents to the agency’s brand using the available tools. Vouchers and confirmations are issued in the agreed format with essential supplier details; reuse of photographs and copy is subject to the relevant rights.
b2b.commercialContactRole: The agency remains the main commercial contact for its client. Ada Tours manages operational and logistical matters in coordination with the agency, following the agreed decision-making process.
b2b.travellerCommunication: We may contact travellers directly about transfers, meeting arrangements and unexpected issues while preserving the partner’s commercial role. The parties agree on confidentiality and how subsequent direct enquiries will be handled.
b2b.proposal: After receiving a detailed enquiry, we prepare an itinerary, inclusions and exclusions, an initial estimate or commercial proposal, and payment and booking terms. Development fees, minimum booking size and terms for any free quotation are agreed before substantial planning begins.
b2b.bookingConfirmation: The proposal states its validity period and distinguishes offered services from confirmed bookings. Availability is checked with suppliers; the terms for securing the price and services are set out in the written confirmation.
b2b.cancellationPolicy: Changes depend on timing, the scope of the request and suppliers’ terms. Group size, travel dates and participant substitutions may affect prices and availability. Penalties and refunds are specified in the terms for each booking.
b2b.emergencySupport: For group projects, we appoint a planning coordinator and share contact details for the trip. In an unexpected situation, we coordinate suppliers and keep the agency informed; availability hours, assistance procedures and included or additional services are defined in the proposal.
b2b.professionalVisits: We agree on the group’s objectives, identify suitable organisations, establish contact, check availability and arrange language assistance where needed. Meetings are confirmed only with the host organisation’s direct consent, taking its schedule, confidentiality and security into account.
b2b.acceptedRequests: Tailor-made itineraries, small delegations, groups and individual services such as transfers, guides and interpreting. Delivery depends on the destination, available resources and the enquiry; minimum group size, budget and lead time are agreed for each project.

approvedNumericClaims: Ada Tours can handle enquiries in seven languages
